description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 5 - TARGET QUALITY. vf4 rejects a candidate whose grid space score (0x143c71ee0) is below 36, and (for a candidate not yet past oppline-12) whose run bearing is less than 52 deg off the reference direction. Lowering 36->30 accepts a slightly more contested arrival point; lowering 52->35 allows straighter, more central late runs rather than only diagonal channel runs. Two disp32 re-aims. The 52 deg meaning is inferred, not emulated - apply this one last. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/latebox-space-quality.json
